title: Verify the selected OpenAI worker path
description: After the target decision, test the selected route in an isolated fixture. For Codex, evaluate the maintained @agentclientprotocol/codex-acp adapter, pin the tested version and use its supported login flow. The installed Codex binary reports 0.171.0-alpha.13, so do not assume adapter compatibility or that an app-bundled executable is a stable deployment dependency. If direct ChatGPT is selected, first establish an actually supported API/protocol path rather than pretending Codex is the same target.
why: The OpenAI target and transport must be explicit.

acceptance.text: Record supported target, adapter and binary versions
Authentication requirement and session behavior are demonstrated
An unsupported route is reported as blocked with evidence
No worker support is claimed from documentation alone
